description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for RLC receive metrics in a wireless communication system, including mode-specific metrics for TM, UM, and AM modes, along with formatting utilities.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics
classes.description: Main data structure for RLC receive metrics, supporting different modes via variant.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for RLC receive metrics collection.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the metrics data to initial state.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of current metrics and increments the internal counter.
